plan.description: Read-only planning agent on GLM-5.2. Plans and aligns with the user. Can research via explore/general/review subagents but cannot delegate execution or edit directly.

orchestrator.description: Orchestrator on GLM-5.2. Plans, aligns with the user, then delegates execution/search/review to cheap subagents. Read-only: never edits or runs bash directly; all behavior-changing work and verification go through subagents.

build.description: Edit-capable primary on GLM-5.2. Delegates heavy work to cheap subagents but can edit directly when convenient. Tab-switch alternative to orchestrator.

general.description: General-purpose execution/research subagent on the cheap model. Use for ad-hoc multi-step work that does not fit implementation/review/explore.

explore.description: Read-only codebase exploration subagent on the cheap model. Use for fast file pattern searches, keyword lookups, and codebase questions.

scout.description: External docs/dependency research subagent on the cheap model. Use to inspect upstream library source and cross-reference docs.
